dedupe_keys.name: input data for a multi period linear programming model for the natural gas distribution network of thailand

description: Input data for A Multi-Period Linear Programming Model for the Natural Gas Distribution Network of Thailand is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Nutmethee Tuchinda. There is the data set for constructing The Programming Model for the Natural Gas Distribution Network of Thailand. The data is referred from the available sources of Thailand. Moreover, the data is converted to be usable parameter before it is used for the programming as the input data, which is described in my paper. Coverage: national (TH); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
